_comment: Rendered to /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json. Schema: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings (apiKeyHelper, env.*, availableModels, enforceAvailableModels, model, modelPicker) and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config (ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU,FABLE}_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL). The entrypoint fills env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL, the alias pins, availableModels, and a replaceBuiltInOptions modelPicker from gateway-models.jsonl (anthropic family, claudeCode tiers). Do not allowlist family aliases (opus/sonnet) — they wildcard every official version. Omnigent readiness credits apiKeyHelper here (omnigent/onboarding/ambient.py claude_managed_gateway) and its picker reads the same env keys plus modelPicker. The helper reads the key from env; no secret in this file.
